The page may be attacker-controlled web content (UNTRUSTED) or the user's authenticated/intranet page reached with the persistent Chrome profile (SECRET).

`closePage` sets `response.setIncludePages(true)`, returning the list of open pages with their URLs/titles: titles/URLs of attacker-visited pages are attacker-controllable (UNTRUSTED) and the user's open tab URLs are private browser-session data (SECRET).
`drag` manipulates an arbitrary page and can return a full snapshot via `response.includeSnapshot()`, mixing attacker page content (UNTRUSTED) with the user's authenticated page content (SECRET).
